title: Sora 2 Prompt Schema
description: JSON schema for validating Sora 2 video generation prompts produced by this skill. Supports both Standard and Pro variants.

prompt.description: Natural language shot description. Structure like a storyboard: camera, subject, action, lighting, physics, audio. First 500 characters carry the most weight. Standard: max ~2,000 chars. Pro: up to 15,000+ chars. NEVER include duration instructions here.

model.description: Sora 2 variant. Standard for iteration (720p, lower cost). Pro for final renders (1080p, max quality, MARS-LSP support).

size.description: Output resolution. 1280x720=landscape, 720x1280=portrait. Source reference images must match.

seconds.description: Video duration in seconds. 1-20s. This is the ONLY way to control duration — prompt text duration instructions are ignored.

input_reference.description: Reference image or video URL for image-to-video transformation. Resolution must match output size. When used, prompt should describe ONLY the desired motion, not re-describe the image.

n.description: Number of variants to generate. Max 1 at 1080p, 2 at 720p, 4 at lower res.

audio.description: Audio direction metadata for pipeline tracking. Audio cues should be embedded in the prompt text for Sora 2, but this field captures structured audio intent for production planning.

ambient.description: Ambient sound description: 'rain on glass, distant city hum'

sfx.description: Sound effects: 'footsteps on gravel, door creaking'

dialogue.description: Spoken lines: 'she says: I am not leaving'

exclusions.description: Elements to exclude. Place at END of prompt: 'No text on signs; avoid lens flares; no unnatural colors.' Keep minimal.

metadata.description: Pipeline metadata. Not sent to the Sora 2 API.

variant_rationale.description: Why this variant and duration were selected

sequential_shot_number.description: Position in a multi-shot sequence for continuity tracking

continuity_notes.description: Notes for maintaining consistency with adjacent shots: character descriptions, lighting state, props present
